acceptanceCriteria: After git-budget-exceeded the walk stops within one further directory read; test asserts the bounded op count and that the fatal error is surfaced.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-1399/1400/1401 lane (PR #922, BASE d47b0f01e). Repro: UnitsSource over affected.FSSource(RevisionFS) of corvint main with the default 1,024-op Git budget. Expected: the walk stops once the reader reports git-budget-exceeded. Actual: it continues ~1.5-2 min and, if Source.Err is ignored, yields 6 units and 3 spurious frontier entries.
title: affected: golang.UnitsSource keeps walking 1.5-2 min after a fatal git-budget-exceeded
